notes.title: 📣 Let us know what you think!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played [b]LEVEL 0: A Backrooms Experience[/b] so far! We hope you enjoyed it and had a blast.

This game is the first in our series of free prototypes that we will be releasing in the future. In our effort to make our games as awesome as they can be, it is crucial for us to hear your [b]feedback[/b] about what you [b]liked and didn’t like[/b].

We’ve created a [b][url=https://forms.microsoft.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=ig2_bxffr06YCBnmIw4l25-a3_7bp5JJhoafrF3XBx9UNTFNUzlLTEZRMzA3RlMwQkszOVJOWlRWVSQlQCN0PWcu](very short) survey[/url][/b] for you guys to fill out. Your responses will be considered and forwarded to this prototype's developers. Your voice will be heard, and you can make all the difference.

[url=https://forms.microsoft.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=ig2_bxffr06YCBnmIw4l25-a3_7bp5JJhoafrF3XBx9UNTFNUzlLTEZRMzA3RlMwQkszOVJOWlRWVSQlQCN0PWcu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798373/822e06877de10e244bb1b19b4daaa6d115267e49.png[/img][/url]
  
We thrive on your feedback, and we want to create something special with you, for you. If you want more of this game, we'll make it happen. Let your voice be heard and help shape the future of this exciting and unique gaming experience. 

Your Team at Headup

[i]The survey will be open to submissions until April 12th 2023. If you have more feedback for us after that point in time, get in touch with us via Steam, Discord, or social media.[/i]

notes.title: Free Prototype out now!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that our first free prototype is now available on Steam! With "LEVEL 0: A Backroom Experience" we're venturing into something entirely new. With your help, we want to try out concepts and game ideas before moving on to full production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798373/4a1b01102eef4878d1199c94f33cf3cc62dd8e38.jpg[/img]

Together with CyberPunch Studios, we came up with the idea of creating our own spin-off in the Backrooms universe. That's how "Level 0" came to be. What you can try out here is just the first step. This is how we envision the framework for a Backrooms game.

Of course, this is just a prototype. That means the ideas aren't fully developed yet, and some mechanics are still straightforward, while there's a lot of potential to explore.

This is where you come in. Try out this prototype, have fun with it, and then let us know what you think of "Level 0." Would you play a full version? Maybe this theme doesn't appeal to you at all?

We would be immensely grateful if you could provide us with feedback. Perhaps you even have some ideas for a potential full version. Please share them with us! Join the conversation in the comments, discussions, or on our [url=https://bit.ly/3Jc65oH]Discord[/url] server. We're simply excited to exchange ideas with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798373/f817c1c529200ddc6d973ab1e463ae3bf8cbcae6.png[/img]

We hope you have lots of fun playing, and we look forward to hearing from you!

Your team at Headup
